source_command.key: Source command list labels key value 74 Alt+J PetInfo. The original key handler sees Alt+J, requires the basic-info owner, deletes/toggles source WID 88, and calls MakeWindow(WID_PETINFOWND) (Ref/UIWindowMgr.cpp:4127-4132). MakeWindow factory 88 returns without creating when m_petJob == -1 (Ref/UIWindowMgr.cpp:6763-6784). The request-0 pet-info snapshot is a separate command-menu action (GameMode2 message id 163 argument 0, Ref/GameMode2.cpp:3875-3880), not the hotkey route.
source_command.owner_context: GameMode2 cases 0x1D-0x21 are CGameMode::SendMsg message-dispatch cases in Ref/GameMode2.cpp (function decompiled from 0x5833a0), with m_menuTargetAID state elsewhere in the same function. Do not relabel them as chat emotion values or infer an unrelated chat caller from their numeric values. The actual PetInfoWnd menu actions are independently proven in UIPetInfoWnd::SendMsg.

outgoing_frames.rename: UIPetInfoWnd button id 118 sends CGameMode::SendMsg id 158 with edit text. In Ref/GameMode2.cpp CGameMode::SendMsg branch 0x9E writes packet opcode 421 decimal = 0x01A5 at bytes 0-1; copies at most 24 name bytes into bytes 2-25 and NUL terminates a full-length copy; generic tail obtains GetPacketSize(421) and sends that frame. Selected PK01.02 registry assigns 0x01A5 fixed length 26 to clif_parse_ChangePetName, offsets 2,0.
outgoing_frames.pet_action: PetInfoWnd command menu sends CGameMode::SendMsg id 163 with one-byte values 1,2,4,3 per mapping above. In Ref/GameMode2.cpp branch 0xA3 writes packet opcode 417 decimal = 0x01A1 at bytes 0-1 and the low-byte argument at byte 2; generic tail obtains GetPacketSize(417) and sends. Selected PK01.02 registry assigns 0x01A1 fixed length 3 to clif_parse_PetMenu, offsets 2,0.

server_contract.pinned_pet_status_contract: docs/packets/contracts/PK07.PET-STATUS.md and docs/packets/evidence/PK07.01-source-contract.md specify selected 20080910 0x01A2 35-byte status layout with name, modified, level, fullness, relationship, accessory id; the packet carries no actor ID or job. Local PE decompile Ref/GameModePacket.cpp:24392-24431 additionally proves values with wire level >=10000 are reinterpreted as Item Collection data (subtract 10000, open WID_ITEMCOLLECTIONWND, copy other fields); otherwise pet fields are copied into legacy pet session state. Current HandlePetStatus always calls ReadStatus, so this legacy receive-side branch distinction/state path is not represented by current handler.

legacy_state_and_lifecycle.factory_gate: Factory 88 (WID_PETINFOWND) returns immediately if m_petJob == -1, otherwise reuses or allocates and owns m_petInfoWnd. The gate depends on pet actor/job state, not merely receipt of the status packet.
legacy_state_and_lifecycle.pet_job: Session constructor initializes m_petJob=-1 (Ref/Session.cpp:18033-18040); login transitions reset it (Ref/LoginMode.cpp:1269-1276 and 1683-1688). Packet 420 decimal (0x01A4) dispatches Zc_Change_Pet_Status (Ref/GameModePacket.cpp:1728-1729); type 0 records pet GID and actor job; types 1/2 refresh job from the pet actor when found (10149-10176). UI factory source is Ref/UIWindowMgr.cpp:6763-6784.
legacy_state_and_lifecycle.egg_index: Inventory snapshot branches set m_petEggIndex when IsPetEgg(itemId) and item is damaged/incubated (Ref/GameModePacket.cpp:11010-11011, 11103-11104, 11199-11200). Return Egg from the PetInfo menu sends request type 3 then reads that exact item, clears its damaged flag, writes it back, sets egg index and pet job to -1, invalidates item UI if present, and deletes PetInfoWnd (Ref/UIFrameWnd.cpp:6307-6319). The separate CGameMode::SendMsg menu action also contains a return-to-egg path with the same local mutations (Ref/GameMode2.cpp:3855-3869); this path is not a server-confirmed ack in the traced client code.
legacy_state_and_lifecycle.current_port_gap: Current src/core/PetState.h status includes valid/name/modified/level/fullness/relationship/accessoryItemId; it comes only from HandlePetStatus (src/gamemode/GameModePacket.cpp:5262-5265, registered for 0x01A2 at 8835-8838). It has no pet job/GID/egg index and packet status cannot prove legacy factory eligibility. Search of current Session/GameMode found no m_petJob or m_petEggIndex equivalents; m_petStatus has no reset path in Session.cpp/GameMode.cpp in inspected source, so stale valid status across lifecycle transitions remains a gap.
